# ioNova AI

> AI-Native ISO 20022 Address Resolution and Entity Intelligence for Payments

ioNova makes payment data ISO 20022 ready with AI-native address resolution. It converts unstructured payment data into SWIFT CBPR+ and SEPA compliant structured addresses with 100% deterministic accuracy before the November 2026 deadline.

## Products

### Address Intelligence
The missing layer in payment infrastructure. Parse, validate, and enrich payment addresses for ISO 20022 compliance across 195 countries.

- [Address Intelligence Overview](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/): Parse, validate, and enrich payment addresses
- [Structured Address Mandate](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/structured-address-mandate/): Meet the November 2026 ISO 20022 mandate required by SWIFT, EPC, and CPMI
- [Business Value](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/structured-address-value/): 98%+ STP, 30% fewer false positives, $8-12B in industry savings
- [Purpose-Built Solution](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/purpose-built-address-solution/): Why postal validation and generic LLMs fail at payment address compliance
- [Implementation](https://ionova.ai/address-intelligence/address-implementation/): Sidecar architecture, 10-16 week timeline, zero legacy rip-and-replace

### Entity Intelligence
Resolve entities across 50+ systems with 95%+ precision and <200ms latency. The only platform with evidence-first AI and progressive autonomy.

- [Entity Intelligence Platform](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/): Overview of entity resolution capabilities
- [Evidence-First AI](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/evidence/): AI copilots that cite their sources with mandatory citations and confidence scores
- [Cascade Resolution](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/cascade/): Reduce entity resolution costs by 90% with multi-stage cascade matching
- [Progressive Autonomy](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/autonomy/): 4-level framework for governing AI agency in regulated enterprises
- [Governance-by-Design](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/governance/): SR 11-7 and EU AI Act compliant with audit-grade evidence packs
- [Overlay Deployment](https://ionova.ai/entity-intelligence/overlay/): Deploy in 90 days, read-only pilot, no rip-and-replace
